title: Inspection and maintenance titles still take more than 50 characters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new inspection template for this test in the Digital Vehicle Inspection builder.
  • Have a new maintenance schedule for this test in the maintenance editor.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open the new inspection template in the Digital Vehicle Inspection builder.
  2. Click the template's title.
  3. Type a 60-character title (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Inspection Template 1).
  4. Open the new maintenance schedule in the maintenance editor.
  5. Click the schedule's title.
  6. Type a 60-character title (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Inspection Template 1).
  7. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Click New Tier.
  9. Type the same 60 characters in the tier name (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Inspection Template 1).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The builder opens with the template's title.

Step 2:

  • The title can be typed in.

Step 3:

  • All 60 characters are in the title: typing goes on past the 50th character.

Step 4:

  • The maintenance editor opens with the schedule's title.

Step 5:

  • The title can be typed in.

Step 6:

  • All 60 characters are in the title: typing goes on past the 50th character.

Step 7:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 8:

  • The New Tier page opens with an empty name.

Step 9:

  • The tier name stops at 50 characters: the 50-character limit is the tier name's own, not the other titles'.
